cells.gaps: Staged on the Chad Digital Strategy Horizon 2030, which the World Bank's 2023 diagnostic recommends adopting (TCD-004); no adoption, text, period, plan or reporting is held for it. The Stratégie nationale de transformation numérique 2020-2030, which ADETIC and others name to 2026 (TCD-001, TCD-006, TCD-008), has no row on its standing or text and may be the same document. The same report's statement of absence (TCD-003) is answered by its own recommendation, so stage 1 does not hold.
cells.note: Raised on review from unplaced: a national strategy in preparation is stage 2, as Djibouti's and South Sudan's are on one row of similar age. Stage 3 needs a source's word of adoption and a public text.
